guardrails.description: Back extensor endurance holds while the hinge gets heavier (Sorensen hold no lower than baseline)
7-day weight trend no faster than -0.75%/wk (protect strength)

rationale: Block 1 is force first, then sharpening into the Open. Of the four focus lifts the hinge is furthest from the hybrid benchmark (69%; squat 95%, DB press 112%, pull-ups 83%), and it is also the lift with the least confidence after the June back pop. Goal: trap bar (high handle) e1RM 124.4 -> 133.7 kg (+7.5%, ~235 -> ~252 lb x5) through graded, predictable exposures at 2 RIR, with a rung move to the low handle only on clean exposures. Guardrails: the Sorensen hold must not drop (the back gets stronger, not just the pull), and recomp weight loss stays slow. Trade-off: hinge volume competes with golf and the running ramp for back recovery, so the hinge sits early in the week, away from Wed/Thu golf.
calorie_phase_reason: Body fat ~14% against a 10-12% goal with weight near the 200 lb target: recomp (small deficit, high protein) keeps strength progressing.
